proposal.hypothesis: Generating terminal payoffs currently makes 64 powf calls per input element, alongside the unchanged 2,016 backward updates. Starting at exponent -64 and advancing by u squared should reduce terminal power generation to one powf plus 63 multiplications; whether that helps overall runtime and whether its FP32 rounding remains within tolerance require controller measurement and varied-input validation.

retained: Replace per-terminal-node powf(u, exponent) calls with one powf(u, -64) followed by multiplication by u*u for indices j=0..63.
Preserve the 64-element terminal array, payoff expression, and backward recurrence order.
